sharedMapEvidence: One implementation, syssi/esphome-pace-bms, reports all three BSLBATT models working against the same PACE_MODBUS register set at the same firmware level (1.51), all from discussion #74. That is one source covering three models, not two sources agreeing — which is why the tag is community-single and not community-crosschecked.

unmappedReports: Per-cell voltage, 16 of them, plus min/max/average/delta cell voltage and the INDEX of the min and max cell. MetricKind has nothing below pack level. This is the largest single gap the PACE map exposes and it is the whole reason people fit a BMS monitor., Per-cell balancing state, 16 booleans, plus a balancer status word. No MetricKind., Warnings bitmask, protections bitmask, fault status bitmask — three separate 16-bit words. Reinforces the missing fault-code kind from every other dialect in this file., Remaining capacity, full capacity and design capacity in amp-hours. MetricKind::ConsumedAmpHours is the inverse of one of these and there is nothing for pack capacity, so state-of-health cannot be derived or cross-checked., Four separate battery temperature probes, plus MOSFET temperature, plus environment temperature. MetricKind::BatteryTemperature is scalar; there is no probe index., Charging / discharging operation flags as distinct from current sign. Not fatal — battery-current sign carries it — but the BMS states them and they are lost.
